Americans' gas prices surge, and Jim Jordan's response is "that's life."


The Tennessee Holler (@TheTNHoller)

COLLINS: “What about Trump’s promise to lower gas prices?” 

JORDAN: “That’s life.”

@kaitlancollins: “If someone’s paying more for⛽️, saying ‘that’s life’ might not make them feel better.”

@Jim_Jordan: “Those are your words, not mine.”

COLLINS: “No you said that. Just now.”😬

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/TheTNHoller/status/2055109985189712014#m

"This Supreme Court has shown that it is nothing but an illegitimate arm of the Republican Party. You have Supreme Court justices who swore up and down they respected precedent as it relates to Roe-- the first thing they did is overturn Roe. Same exact thing with redistricting. Swore they supported it-- until they didn't."

Video

BTC: As Republicans continue to go down this path and gerrymander states across the country, I hope the next governor of California goes 52-0. I hope the governor of New York, Kathy Hochul, goes 26-0.

@KatiePavlich: So you're for gerrymandering now?

BTC: I am across the board against gerrymandering, but not for unilaterally disarming.

Video

"The same Supreme Court that told Black voters in Alabama and Texas that they’d have to live with illegal maps because a primary was four months away had no problem blowing up an ongoing election in Louisiana."
